The '''Hasikian''' were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Hasiki system/Legends|Hasiki system]]. They were known to have prominent scales over their heads. A notable Hasikian was [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[T'Seely]], who escorted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
